title: Reclamation: Core Loop
summary: Stabilize soil, water, crops, storage, and routes one field at a time.

blocks.title: Repeatable Loop
blocks.body: Recover seed stock, prepare soil, grow a reliable food baseline, then expand into utility crops or higher-risk farming inputs once power and water are stable.

blocks.title: Pressure Check
blocks.body: After each planting pass, check whether water, soil quality, crop choice, storage, and access paths match the settlement's next need.

blocks.title: Stop Point
blocks.body: Stop before the farm outgrows your ability to defend, irrigate, or harvest it. A smaller reliable plot beats a hungry sprawl.

blocks.title: Loop Anchor
blocks.body: Treat this as a material checkpoint: if it helps the loop, bring it home before chasing bulk.
blocks.label: Wheat
blocks.subtitle: Core Loop checkpoint
